# Action golden fixtures

Generated by `cargo run -p xtask -- action-fixtures`. Do not edit by hand;
the output is deterministic and CI checks it with `git diff --exit-code`.

All times are relative to `NOW = 1800000000` (2027-01-15 08:00 UTC). Tests must use a
fixed clock at `NOW`. Agent `agent_0000000000000001`, client `client_0000000000000001`.
Key seeds: root 0x11, catalog 0x22, command 0x33, rogue 0x44 (repeated 32 times).

## Trust documents

- `root.pub.hex`: the root public key (compile it in as the single root, threshold 1).
- `manifest.env`: root-signed manifest (seq 1). Catalog key holds catalog, artifact-revoke and
techlist; command key holds command. Thresholds 1. capability_ceiling [service, files.write].
- `revocations.env`: catalog-signed revocations (seq 1) listing the content id of
`definition-revoked.env`.

## Definitions (envelopes, type rmm.definition/1)

- `definition-valid.env`: the spooler definition signed by the catalog key.
- `definition-revoked.env`: a spooler variant (id printing.spooler-revoked) signed by the catalog key; revoked.
- `definition-rogue.env`: the spooler definition signed by a key that is not certified.
- `definition-unknown-block.env`: catalog-signed; contains block `shell.exec`.
- `definition-param.env`: catalog-signed; declares int param `wait_s` (1..=120, required).

## Commands (envelopes, type rmm.command/1, signed by the command key)

- `cmd-valid.env`: valid spooler invocation (issued NOW-10, expires NOW+590).
- `cmd-expired.env`: expires at NOW-400 (outside the 300 s skew).
- `cmd-replay.env`: valid; feed the same bytes twice, the second must be a replay.
- `cmd-tampered.env`: `cmd-valid.env` with one payload bit flipped (bad signature).
- `cmd-revoked.env`: invokes `definition-revoked.env`.
- `cmd-rogue-definition.env`: invokes `definition-rogue.env` (definition not catalog-signed).
- `cmd-wrong-agent.env`: addressed to `agent_0000000000000002`.
- `cmd-unknown-block.env`: invokes `definition-unknown-block.env` (fails static validation).
- `cmd-bad-param.env`: invokes `definition-param.env` with `wait_s = 9999` (fails param validation).
- `cmd-good-param.env`: invokes `definition-param.env` with `wait_s = 30` (passes).
